ZORR MODE

LOGICAL_AGENT = DUNCAN PRIME
OWNER_DIRECTIVE = 2D anime production hierarchy replaces Babylon-first production
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1
STATE = ACTIVE SINGLE PRODUCTION GATE / SMOKE NOT YET RUN

# OWNER PRODUCTION PIVOT — AUTHORITATIVE FOR CURRENT WORK

New production hierarchy:

`DUNCAN PRIME -> MATH/QC ENGINE -> DESIGN ENGINE + DRAW ENGINE + SCENE ENGINE -> KEY DRAWING -> OPENTOONZ PRIMARY -> Plastic/Skeleton/Xsheet -> micro acting + secondary motion -> 2.5D camera/parallax/FX -> RENDER`

Babylon is no longer scene master.

`BABYLON_ROLE = OPTIONAL_3D_SPATIAL_CALCULATOR`

Use Babylon only when a shot actually requires real 3D evidence such as complex perspective/orbit, spatial contact, weapon trajectories, occlusion geometry, difficult architecture, or difficult camera motion. Any Babylon result returns camera/depth/projection/mask evidence back into 2D production.

# FROZEN / NOT ACTIVE CRITICAL PATH

Preserve existing artifacts/history but stop expanding these for their own sake:
- Babylon infrastructure/framework growth;
- custom deformation/rigging engines;
- custom animation frameworks;
- custom scene editors;
- new bridges/daemons/runners without a proven smoke blocker;
- extreme pose retargeting from one PNG;
- broad alternative-program research after a sufficient ready-made path is found.

Nothing is deleted. Existing Babylon work is retained as spatial mathematics / previz evidence.

# PRODUCTION LAWS

## CHARACTER SYSTEM
`IDENTITY -> MODEL SHEET -> MOVABLE PARTS -> RIG -> CONTROLLED DEFORMATION -> EXPRESSIONS -> KEY POSES`

Primary character test: can the same identity survive repeated production use across many frames?

## KEY DRAWING FIRST
Strong pose/head/acting changes come from new key drawings. Plastic interpolation is bounded between compatible keys; one raster is not stretched into every pose.

## DESIGN FOR ANIMATION
A character design that cannot be decomposed into coherent movable/layered masses is a production defect even if the still image is attractive.

## MATH/QC ROLE
Math does not author motion. It detects breakage in motion, including head rotation, mesh distortion, landmark drift, silhouette-area drift, joint limits, secondary lag, camera velocity, parallax ratio, and timing.

## SCENE ROLE
Start from the anime shot and build only the minimum spatial model required by that shot. Ordinary shots should prefer 2D layers + Z depth + camera + parallax + scale/rotation/timing.

# SINGLE ACTIVE NEXT GATE

`OPENTOONZ CHARACTER LIFE SMOKE R01`

No new architecture before this smoke.
No new code.
No new framework.
No Babylon repair.
No AI image generation.
No image editing without the OWNER's exact image-edit command.
No alternative animation package evaluation unless OpenToonz Plastic physically fails the smoke use case.

Required smoke:
- 48 frames;
- 1920x1080;
- 24 fps;
- exactly 1 ZORR character;
- 1 background;
- 1 camera;
- 1 torso motion;
- 1 head motion;
- 1 secondary element;
- 1 parallax move.

Required chain:
`DRAWING -> RIG -> BREATH -> HEAD -> SECONDARY -> PARALLAX -> 48 FRAME RENDER`

Evaluate only:
A. IDENTITY — face/silhouette do not drift beyond acceptable key/rig deformation.
B. RIG — Plastic mesh/skeleton does not tear/collapse.
C. ACTING — breathing/body motion does not read as global PNG scaling.
D. SECONDARY — hair/cloth/accessory motion adds readable life without damaging identity.
E. CAMERA — 2.5D depth/parallax remains readable.
F. RENDER — clean 48-frame output exists.

No scalar beauty score. Exact failures remain separate.

# READY-MADE PRIMARY MECHANISM

Primary tool = OpenToonz native Plastic/Skeleton/Xsheet/Function Editor/2.5D camera path.

Upstream evidence already inspected before this issue:
- OpenToonz 1.8 current release family;
- native Plastic workflow deforms a texture column through a generated mesh + skeleton;
- Plastic supports skeleton deformation/keyframes and Xsheet/Timeline integration;
- Function Editor supports motion-channel adjustment;
- this is the first sufficient mature OSS mechanism, so alternatives are frozen until physical failure.

A Linux packaging candidate was also found for execution-environment probing only:
- `pkgforge-dev/OpenToonz-AppImage`
- release `OpenToonz: 1.8.0-3`
- tag `1.8.0-3@2026-08-22_1787395220`
- asset digest `sha256:7dc22b97d45ea17046b6c6f98922ce050878ddd7ca4ece4d55319854bf0a6016`

This package discovery is NOT a runtime PASS and does not replace official OpenToonz authority.

# SELECTED ZORR SOURCE PACK

Use existing `C00_SOURCE_PACK_R01`, status `PROVISIONAL / STRONG STUDY SOURCE`.

C00-A DETAIL/COSTUME/ACCESSORY
SHA256 = `94c185aea5755e569f8359fd29c6e0b8a1748e1613f2b59e7a3e280205dcbc8e`

C00-B HEAD YAW
SHA256 = `7646fa2724fd4372eb9811635dbf71bb052151eaf2d4cdb999159124660a16d1`

C00-C MASTER FRONT
SHA256 = `57fbec5d9c136a90c6ac262f8011665fa061dca427bf3fb2c3f110d1cb0a69ed`
Library filename = `8b45ccb3-e979-4422-9145-b873985424f7.png`

C00-D BODY TURNAROUND
SHA256 = `49f1c5fa9973f185c4ed7441325e2705d392449f6d59b4592ec6d81bc4b4da82`

Source pack already provides identity/front/turnaround/head-yaw/costume evidence. Do not generate a replacement character for the smoke.

# CURRENT PHYSICAL BLOCKERS — FRESH / FAIL-CLOSED

1. `OPENTOONZ_RUNTIME_NOT_ACCESSIBLE_FROM_CURRENT_EXECUTION_ENVIRONMENT`
Current accessible container does not have `opentoonz`, `tcomposer`, or `tcleanupper`; apt has no OpenToonz package; current container cannot directly fetch the discovered GitHub release asset. Therefore no OpenToonz scene/render has physically executed yet.

2. `SOURCE_SPLIT_NOT_READY`
The selected source PNGs are flattened against an opaque white background. Current Library search did not surface a ready layered PSD/KRA/TNZ or separated movable-parts version. This is a search result, not a claim that no such asset exists anywhere.

These blockers do NOT authorize a custom rigging/deformation framework, a new runner, image generation, or image editing.

# LEGAL NEXT ORDER

1. Reuse any already-existing accessible OpenToonz runtime if durable evidence reveals one; do not build a new execution architecture.
2. Reuse an already-existing separated/layered version of C00 if found.
3. If no separated source exists, source splitting becomes the exact asset-prep blocker; do not silently edit/generate image bytes without OWNER's exact image-edit authorization.
4. Once runtime + movable source exist: run the exact 48-frame native OpenToonz Plastic smoke.
5. Measure A-F using existing Math/QC evidence only after render exists.
6. Only if native Plastic physically fails the use case may the next mature OSS animation mechanism be evaluated.

# TERMINAL STATES

`RUNTIME_READY` = exact OpenToonz executable/version physically available.
`SOURCE_SPLIT_READY` = character has the minimum movable-part/layer representation required by the smoke.
`RIG_READY` = native Plastic mesh/skeleton physically created and deformable.
`SMOKE_RENDERED` = exact 48-frame 1920x1080/24fps output physically exists.
`SMOKE_QC_PASS` = A-F fresh evidence all acceptable.
`BLOCKED` = exact first missing physical layer named; no architecture detour.

CURRENT = `BLOCKED / RUNTIME + SOURCE_SPLIT NOT YET PHYSICALLY READY`

IMAGE_GENERATION = NO
IMAGE_EDITING = NO
CUSTOM_CODE = NO
NEW_FRAMEWORK = NO
NEW_RUNNER = NO
BABYLON_REPAIR = NO
MERGE = NO
CANON = NO
PRODUCTION_PASS = NO
